opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship 2027

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000 (stated in the 2026 context; 2027 amount not separately stated)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Young people aged 18-24, resident in the UK, with a demonstrable interest in the relevant sector (2027 plans award three dairy and three pig scholarships).
opportunities.summary: A 30-day fully funded study tour for young people aged 18-24, linking successful applicants directly to farmers via the Nuffield Scholar network to develop young talent in the industry. Includes all travel and subsistence, attendance at the Nuffield Conference, Nuffield Farming Associate membership, and a £1,000 financial incentive to part-cover replacement labour cost. Applications open in November 2026.
